payload.content:
Build a functional MVP for REGEN, a railway infrastructure monitoring and maintenance platform designed initially for South African railway operations.  
REGEN must focus on combining EXISTING RAILWAY OPERATIONAL DATA, especially TRACK CIRCUIT STATUS, with additional infrastructure-condition monitoring using FBG sensors.  
IMPORTANT:  
This is an MVP/prototype, not a safety-certified railway signalling system. Do not attempt to control real railway signals, track circuits or trains. The system is READ-ONLY and provides decision support for engineers, control-room staff and maintenance teams.  
CORE REGEN CONCEPT  
==================================================  
REGEN connects:  
Track Circuit Monitoring  
Railway Asset Monitoring  
+  
FBG Structural Strain Monitoring  
+  
Fault Detection  
+  
Field Inspection  
+  
Maintenance Management  
The central workflow is:  
MONITOR  
→ DETECT  
→ INVESTIGATE  
→ VERIFY  
→ INSPECT  
→ MAINTAIN  
→ VERIFY  
The system should answer:  
  
What is happening?  
  
Where is it happening?  
  
Which railway asset is affected?  
  
Is the issue operational, infrastructure-related or sensor-related?  
  
What evidence supports the alert?  
  
Does it require physical verification?  
  
Who needs to respond?  
  
Has the problem been resolved?  
==================================================  
  
PRIMARY HARDWARE / DATA SOURCES  
==================================================  
The MVP should model two main monitoring sources.  
A. TRACK CIRCUIT MONITORING  
Track circuits are the primary operational monitoring input.  
Use simulated track-circuit data.  
Each track circuit should contain:  
  
track_circuit_id  
  
section_id  
  
railway_line  
  
location  
  
status  
  
occupancy  
  
signal_relationship  
  
last_update  
  
fault_status  
Possible states:  
NORMAL  
OCCUPIED  
FAULT  
UNKNOWN  
OFFLINE  
IMPORTANT:  
Do not imply that REGEN directly controls track circuits.  
REGEN receives or simulates READ-ONLY status information from an existing railway signalling/monitoring system.  
Example:  
Track Circuit:  
TC-021  
Section:  
GAUTENG-SEC-04  
Status:  
OCCUPIED  
Last Update:  
  
10:42:18  
Signal Relationship:  
S-021  
FBG STRUCTURAL MONITORING  
==================================================  
Add Fiber Bragg Grating sensors as a SECONDARY infrastructure-condition monitoring layer.  
FBG sensors should NOT replace track circuits.  
Track circuits answer:  
"Is this track section occupied / is there an operational detection issue?"  
FBG sensors answer:  
"Is the monitored physical infrastructure showing abnormal strain behaviour?"  
This distinction is extremely important.  
Each FBG sensor should contain:  
sensor_id  
  
asset_id  
  
asset_type  
  
baseline_strain  
  
current_strain  
  
deviation  
  
percentage_change  
  
trend  
  
wavelength  
  
sensor_status  
  
risk_level  
  
last_reading  
Example:  
Sensor:  
FBG-00021  
Asset:  
COMPOSITE-SLEEPER-021  
Baseline:  
  
250 µε  
Current:  
  
612 µε  
Deviation:  
+362 µε  
Percentage Change:  
+144.8%  
Trend:  
INCREASING  
Risk:  
SIMULATED WARNING  
IMPORTANT:  
Do not automatically classify a strain value as structural failure.  
Risk must be represented as SIMULATED for the MVP and should conceptually depend on:  
baseline  
+  
trend  
+  
operating conditions  
+  
engineering thresholds  
DATA RELATIONSHIP  
==================================================  
Use this relationship:  
Railway Line  
→ Section  
→ Track Circuit  
→ Signal  
→ Physical Asset  
→ FBG Sensor  
→ Alerts  
→ Inspection  
→ Maintenance  
Example:  
GAUTENG CORRIDOR  
↓  
SECTION-04  
↓  
TC-021  
↓  
SIGNAL-S-021  
↓  
COMPOSITE-SLEEPER-021  
↓  
FBG-00021  
The system should allow the user to move from a network-level problem to the affected asset and then to the relevant sensor.  
==================================================  
  
MAIN DASHBOARD  
==================================================  
Create a professional railway control-room dashboard.  
Header:  
REGEN  
Railway Infrastructure Intelligence  
Navigation:  
Dashboard  
Network  
Track Circuits  
Assets  
FBG Monitoring  
Alerts  
Inspections  
Maintenance  
Reports  
Dashboard cards:  
TOTAL TRACK SECTIONS  
OCCUPIED  
TRACK CIRCUIT FAULTS  
INFRASTRUCTURE WARNINGS  
CRITICAL ASSETS  
FBG SENSOR STATUS  
ACTIVE ALERTS  
OPEN MAINTENANCE TASKS  
Main dashboard sections:  
  
Railway Network Map  
  
Track Circuit Status  
  
Infrastructure Condition  
  
Active Alerts  
  
FBG Sensor Trends  
  
Maintenance Tasks  
==================================================  
  
NETWORK MAP  
==================================================  
Create a simplified railway network visualisation.  
Show:  
Railway lines  
Sections  
Track circuits  
Signals  
Infrastructure assets  
Use status indicators:  
Green = Normal  
Amber = Warning  
Red = Critical/Fault  
Grey = Offline/Unknown  
Blue = Occupied/Operational state  
Do not make the map overly decorative.  
Prioritise operational clarity.  
==================================================  
  
TRACK CIRCUIT PAGE  
==================================================  
Create a dedicated Track Circuit Monitoring page.  
Display:  
Track Circuit ID  
Section  
Railway Line  
Current Status  
Occupancy  
Related Signal  
Last Update  
Fault Status  
Example:  
TC-021  
Gauteng Corridor  
Section 04  
STATUS:  
FAULT  
OCCUPANCY:  
UNKNOWN  
RELATED SIGNAL:  
S-021  
LAST UPDATE:  
  
10:42:18  
FAULT:  
Track circuit communication failure  
ACTION:  
Physical verification required  
Add a timeline showing:  
Normal  
→  
Fault Detected  
→  
Investigation  
→  
Technician Assigned  
→  
Resolved  
→  
Verified  
ASSET DETAIL PAGE  
==================================================  
When the user selects an asset, display:  
Asset ID  
Asset Type  
Location  
Current Condition  
Related Track Circuit  
Related Signal  
FBG Sensors  
Active Alerts  
Inspection History  
Maintenance History  
Example:  
COMPOSITE-SLEEPER-021  
Condition:  
WARNING  
Track Circuit:  
TC-021  
FBG Sensor:  
FBG-00021  
Active Alert:  
Elevated strain trend  
==================================================  
  
FBG MONITORING PAGE  
==================================================  
Create a professional FBG monitoring interface.  
Display:  
Sensor ID  
Asset  
Baseline  
Current strain  
Deviation  
Percentage change  
Trend  
Risk  
Sensor status  
Create a time-series chart.  
Example:  
Baseline = 250 µε  
Current = 612 µε  
Deviation = +362 µε  
Change = +144.8%  
Trend = Increasing  
Risk = Simulated Warning  
The graph should show:  
Baseline  
Current readings  
Trend  
Warning threshold  
Critical threshold  
Clearly label thresholds as simulated engineering limits.  
==================================================  
  
ALERT ENGINE  
==================================================  
Create a simulated alert engine.  
Alerts can originate from:  
TRACK CIRCUIT  
FBG SENSOR  
ASSET  
COMMUNICATION  
MAINTENANCE  
Examples:  
TRACK CIRCUIT FAULT  
"TC-021 has entered a fault state."  
FBG WARNING  
"FBG-00021 shows an increasing strain trend compared with its baseline."  
COMBINED ALERT  
"TC-021 fault detected near COMPOSITE-SLEEPER-021. FBG-00021 also reports abnormal strain behaviour. Physical verification recommended."  
IMPORTANT:  
Do not automatically claim that the FBG sensor caused the track-circuit fault.  
The system should present them as separate evidence sources that may be spatially related.  
==================================================  
  
ALERT PRIORITY  
==================================================  
Use:  
NORMAL  
WARNING  
CRITICAL  
OFFLINE  
REQUIRES VERIFICATION  
Example:  
Track circuit fault:  
WARNING  
Track circuit fault + infrastructure anomaly:  
HIGH PRIORITY / REQUIRES VERIFICATION  
Critical status should only be simulated and should not imply a real railway safety decision.  
==================================================  
  
FIELD INSPECTION  
==================================================  
Create a mobile/tablet-friendly inspection interface.  
When an alert requires physical verification:  
Create Inspection Task  
Display:  
Task ID  
Asset  
Location  
Reason  
Related Track Circuit  
Related FBG Sensor  
Priority  
Assigned Inspector  
Status  
Inspector can:  
Open task  
View location  
View asset  
View sensor readings  
View track-circuit status  
Add observation  
Upload photograph  
Record fault  
Confirm fault  
Reject false alarm  
Recommend maintenance  
Complete inspection  
==================================================  
  
MAINTENANCE  
==================================================  
Create a maintenance workflow:  
Alert  
→ Investigation  
→ Inspection  
→ Maintenance  
→ Verification  
→ Resolution  
Maintenance record:  
Maintenance ID  
Asset  
Fault  
Cause  
Assigned Technician  
Work Description  
Start Time  
Completion Time  
Status  
Verification Result  
Statuses:  
OPEN  
ASSIGNED  
IN PROGRESS  
COMPLETED  
VERIFICATION REQUIRED  
VERIFIED  
CLOSED  
==================================================  
  
SUPABASE DATABASE  
==================================================  
Use Supabase/PostgreSQL.  
Create a relational schema with proper foreign keys.  
Recommended entity chain:  
organisations  
→ railway_lines  
→ sections  
→ track_circuits  
→ signals  
railway_lines  
→ sections  
→ assets  
→ fbg_sensors  
assets  
→ alerts  
→ inspections  
→ maintenance_tasks  
fbg_sensors  
→ fbg_readings  
track_circuits  
→ track_circuit_events  
alerts  
→ inspections  
inspections  
→ maintenance_tasks  
maintenance_tasks  
→ maintenance_verifications  
Create appropriate indexes for:  
organisation_id  
railway_line_id  
section_id  
asset_id  
track_circuit_id  
sensor_id  
status  
created_at  
timestamp  
Use UUID primary keys where appropriate.  
==================================================  
  
SEED DATA  
==================================================  
Create realistic simulated South African railway data.  
Include:  
  
3 railway lines  
  
10 sections  
  
20 track circuits  
  
10 signals  
  
30 infrastructure assets  
  
20 FBG sensors  
  
1000+ simulated FBG readings  
  
100+ track-circuit events  
  
20 alerts  
  
15 inspections  
  
10 maintenance tasks  
Use realistic but fictional locations.  
Do not claim that the data represents real PRASA or Transnet infrastructure.  
FBG DATA SIMULATION  
==================================================  
Generate simulated time-series data.  
Most sensors should show relatively stable readings.  
Some should show:  
Stable  
Increasing  
Decreasing  
Sudden change  
Sensor offline  
Example:  
FBG-00021  
250  
  
254  
  
251  
  
258  
  
265  
  
281  
  
310  
  
355  
  
420  
  
510  
  
612 µε  
This should create an obvious increasing trend.  
Calculate:  
deviation =  
current_strain - baseline_strain  
percentage_change =  
((current_strain - baseline_strain) / baseline_strain) * 100  
For:  
baseline = 250  
current = 612  
Result:  
deviation = 362 µε  
percentage change = 144.8%  
TRACK CIRCUIT SIMULATION  
==================================================  
Generate realistic track-circuit state changes.  
Example:  
TC-021  
10:35 NORMAL  
  
10:38 OCCUPIED  
  
10:40 OCCUPIED  
  
10:42 FAULT  
  
10:43 FAULT  
  
10:47 UNKNOWN  
  
10:50 NORMAL  
Allow these events to appear in the event timeline.  
COMBINED INFRASTRUCTURE VIEW  
==================================================  
Create an asset intelligence view.  
Example:  
ASSET:  
COMPOSITE-SLEEPER-021  
Track Circuit:  
TC-021  
Track Circuit:  
FAULT  
FBG Sensor:  
FBG-00021  
FBG:  
Increasing strain  
Asset Condition:  
REQUIRES VERIFICATION  
This is the key REGEN concept:  
MULTIPLE DATA SOURCES  
→  
CONTEXT  
→  
EVIDENCE  
→  
DECISION  
→  
ACTION  
==================================================  
  
UI DESIGN  
==================================================  
Use this REGEN colour system:  
Deep Navy:  
#0B1F33  
Railway Blue:  
#145DA0  
Cyan:  
#00A6C7  
Background:  
#F5F7FA  
White:  
#FFFFFF  
Primary Text:  
#172B3A  
Secondary Text:  
#64748B  
Border:  
#D9E1E8  
Healthy:  
#16A34A  
Warning:  
#F59E0B  
Critical:  
#DC2626  
Offline:  
#6B7280  
Use status colours only where meaningful.  
Avoid:  
neon colours  
excessive gradients  
gaming interfaces  
excessive glassmorphism  
unnecessary animations  
decorative futuristic graphics  
The interface should feel like a professional railway operations and infrastructure-management platform.  
==================================================  
  
RESPONSIVE DESIGN  
==================================================  
Support:  
Desktop  
Tablet  
Mobile  
Desktop is the primary control-room experience.  
Tablet/mobile is primarily for field inspection and maintenance.  
==================================================  
  
TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS  
==================================================  
Use:  
Frontend:  
React + TypeScript  
Styling:  
Tailwind CSS  
Backend:  
Supabase  
Database:  
PostgreSQL  
Charts:  
Recharts or equivalent  
Maps:  
Use a map component suitable for a prototype.  
Authentication:  
Supabase Auth  
Use environment variables for credentials.  
Do not hard-code Supabase keys.  
==================================================  
  
MVP LIMITATIONS  
==================================================  
Clearly label simulated data.  
The MVP must NOT:  
Control real railway signals.  
Control real track circuits.  
Control trains.  
Issue safety-critical commands.  
Claim railway certification.  
Automatically diagnose structural failure.  
Claim that an FBG reading alone proves a fault.  
The MVP demonstrates:  
DATA COLLECTION  
→  
MONITORING  
→  
CORRELATION  
→  
ALERTING  
→  
INVESTIGATION  
→  
FIELD VERIFICATION  
→  
MAINTENANCE  
→  
VERIFICATION  
==================================================  
  
FINAL MVP DEMONSTRATION  
==================================================  
Create one complete demonstration scenario:  
  
TC-021 changes from NORMAL to FAULT.  
  
REGEN detects the event.  
  
The dashboard displays an alert.  
  
User opens TC-021.  
  
User sees the affected section and related asset.  
  
User opens COMPOSITE-SLEEPER-021.  
  
REGEN displays FBG-00021.  
  
FBG trend shows increasing strain.  
  
REGEN identifies the situation as REQUIRES VERIFICATION.  
  
User creates an inspection task.  
  
Inspector receives the task.  
  
Inspector records a physical finding.  
  
Maintenance task is created.  
  
Maintenance is completed.  
  
Post-maintenance FBG readings return towards baseline.  
  
Track circuit returns to NORMAL.  
  
Asset is marked VERIFIED.  
  
Alert is closed.  
==================================================  
  
SUCCESS CRITERIA  
==================================================  
The MVP is successful if a user can understand:  
WHAT happened?  
WHERE did it happen?  
WHICH asset is affected?  
WHAT evidence is available?  
DOES it require physical verification?  
WHO is responsible?  
WHAT action is required?  
HAS it been resolved?  
Build the MVP as a coherent working product, not a collection of disconnected screens.  
Prioritise functionality, realistic data relationships, clear UX and the connection between track-circuit monitoring and FBG-based infrastructure monitoring. also make the platform dynamic

$schema = @'
-- ============================================================
-- REGEN Railway Infrastructure Monitoring Platform
-- Database Schema - PostgreSQL / Supabase
-- ============================================================

-- Enable UUID extension
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp";

-- ============================================================
-- ORGANISATIONS
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS organisations (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  country TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'South Africa',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- ============================================================
-- RAILWAY LINES
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS railway_lines (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  organisation_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES organisations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  description TEXT,
  total_length_km NUMERIC(8,2),
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPERATIONAL' CHECK (status IN ('OPERATIONAL','PARTIAL','SUSPENDED')),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_railway_lines_org ON railway_lines(organisation_id);

-- ============================================================
-- SECTIONS
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sections (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  railway_line_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES railway_lines(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  start_location TEXT NOT NULL,
  end_location TEXT NOT NULL,
  length_km NUMERIC(6,2),
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPERATIONAL' CHECK (status IN ('OPERATIONAL','RESTRICTED','MAINTENANCE','SUSPENDED')),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sections_line ON sections(railway_line_id);

-- ============================================================
-- TRACK CIRCUITS
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS track_circuits (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  track_circuit_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  section_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sections(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  railway_line_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES railway_lines(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  location_description TEXT NOT NULL,
  latitude NUMERIC(10,6),
  longitude NUMERIC(10,6),
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NORMAL' CHECK (status IN ('NORMAL','OCCUPIED','FAULT','UNKNOWN','OFFLINE')),
  occupancy BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  signal_relationship TEXT,
  last_update TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  fault_status TEXT,
  fault_description TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tc_section ON track_circuits(section_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tc_railway_line ON track_circuits(railway_line_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tc_status ON track_circuits(status);

-- ============================================================
-- TRACK CIRCUIT EVENTS
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS track_circuit_events (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  track_circuit_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES track_circuits(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  previous_status TEXT NOT NULL,
  new_status TEXT NOT NULL,
  event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  timestamp TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tce_tc ON track_circuit_events(track_circuit_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tce_timestamp ON track_circuit_events(timestamp DESC);

-- ============================================================
-- SIGNALS
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS signals (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  signal_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  track_circuit_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES track_circuits(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  section_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sections(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  location_description TEXT NOT NULL,
  signal_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'COLOUR_LIGHT',
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NORMAL' CHECK (status IN ('NORMAL','CAUTION','STOP','FAULT','OFFLINE')),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_signals_tc ON signals(track_circuit_id);

-- ============================================================
-- ASSETS
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS assets (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  asset_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  section_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sections(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  track_circuit_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES track_circuits(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  signal_id UUID REFERENCES signals(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  asset_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  location_description TEXT NOT NULL,
  latitude NUMERIC(10,6),
  longitude NUMERIC(10,6),
  installation_date DATE NOT NULL,
  condition TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GOOD' CHECK (condition IN ('GOOD','FAIR','WARNING','CRITICAL','REQUIRES_VERIFICATION','UNKNOWN')),
  last_inspection_date DATE,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assets_section ON assets(section_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assets_tc ON assets(track_circuit_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assets_condition ON assets(condition);

-- ============================================================
-- FBG SENSORS
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fbg_sensors (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  sensor_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  asset_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  sensor_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  baseline_strain NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,
  current_strain NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,
  deviation NUMERIC(10,2) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (current_strain - baseline_strain) STORED,
  percentage_change NUMERIC(8,2) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (
    CASE WHEN baseline_strain <> 0
    THEN ((current_strain - baseline_strain) / baseline_strain) * 100
    ELSE 0 END
  ) STORED,
  trend TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'STABLE' CHECK (trend IN ('STABLE','INCREASING','DECREASING','SUDDEN_CHANGE','OFFLINE')),
  wavelength_nm NUMERIC(10,4) NOT NULL,
  sensor_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ONLINE' CHECK (sensor_status IN ('ONLINE','OFFLINE','DEGRADED','CALIBRATING')),
  risk_level TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'LOW' CHECK (risk_level IN ('LOW','MODERATE','WARNING','HIGH','CRITICAL','OFFLINE')),
  warning_threshold NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 400,
  critical_threshold NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 600,
  last_reading TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_fbg_asset ON fbg_sensors(asset_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_fbg_status ON fbg_sensors(sensor_status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_fbg_risk ON fbg_sensors(risk_level);

-- ============================================================
-- FBG READINGS (time-series)
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fbg_readings (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  sensor_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES fbg_sensors(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  strain_value NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,
  temperature NUMERIC(6,2),
  wavelength_nm NUMERIC(10,4) NOT NULL,
  timestamp TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_fbgr_sensor ON fbg_readings(sensor_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_fbgr_timestamp ON fbg_readings(timestamp DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_fbgr_sensor_time ON fbg_readings(sensor_id, timestamp DESC);

-- ============================================================
-- ALERTS
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS alerts (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  alert_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('TRACK_CIRCUIT','FBG_SENSOR','ASSET','COMMUNICATION','MAINTENANCE','COMBINED')),
  priority TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NORMAL' CHECK (priority IN ('NORMAL','WARNING','HIGH','CRITICAL','OFFLINE')),
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN' CHECK (status IN ('OPEN','ACKNOWLEDGED','INVESTIGATING','RESOLVED','CLOSED')),
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  asset_id UUID REFERENCES assets(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  track_circuit_id UUID REFERENCES track_circuits(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  sensor_id UUID REFERENCES fbg_sensors(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  section_id UUID REFERENCES sections(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  railway_line_id UUID REFERENCES railway_lines(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  evidence_summary TEXT,
  requires_inspection BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  acknowledged_by TEXT,
  acknowledged_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  resolved_by TEXT,
  resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_alerts_status ON alerts(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_alerts_priority ON alerts(priority);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_alerts_asset ON alerts(asset_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_alerts_tc ON alerts(track_circuit_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_alerts_sensor ON alerts(sensor_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_alerts_section ON alerts(section_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_alerts_created ON alerts(created_at DESC);

-- ============================================================
-- INSPECTIONS
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS inspections (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  inspection_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  alert_id UUID REFERENCES alerts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  asset_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  track_circuit_id UUID REFERENCES track_circuits(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  sensor_id UUID REFERENCES fbg_sensors(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT NOT NULL,
  priority TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NORMAL',
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK (status IN ('PENDING','ASSIGNED','IN_PROGRESS','COMPLETED','CANCELLED')),
  assigned_inspector TEXT,
  inspector_id TEXT,
  scheduled_date TIMESTAMPTZ,
  started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  location_description TEXT NOT NULL,
  observations TEXT,
  findings TEXT,
  fault_confirmed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  false_alarm BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  photos JSONB DEFAULT '[]',
  recommendations TEXT,
  maintenance_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_insp_asset ON inspections(asset_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_insp_alert ON inspections(alert_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_insp_status ON inspections(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_insp_created ON inspections(created_at DESC);

-- ============================================================
-- MAINTENANCE TASKS
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS maintenance_tasks (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  maintenance_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  inspection_id UUID REFERENCES inspections(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  alert_id UUID REFERENCES alerts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  asset_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  fault_description TEXT NOT NULL,
  root_cause TEXT,
  work_description TEXT NOT NULL,
  assigned_technician TEXT,
  technician_id TEXT,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN' CHECK (status IN ('OPEN','ASSIGNED','IN_PROGRESS','COMPLETED','VERIFICATION_REQUIRED','VERIFIED','CLOSED')),
  priority TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NORMAL',
  started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  estimated_hours NUMERIC(5,2),
  actual_hours NUMERIC(5,2),
  parts_used TEXT,
  cost_estimate NUMERIC(10,2),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_maint_asset ON maintenance_tasks(asset_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_maint_status ON maintenance_tasks(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_maint_created ON maintenance_tasks(created_at DESC);

-- ============================================================
-- MAINTENANCE VERIFICATIONS
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS maintenance_verifications (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  maintenance_task_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES maintenance_tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  verified_by TEXT NOT NULL,
